articles.title: India-ASEAN Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) Partnership Framework
articles.summary: India and ASEAN launched a strategic initiative to export modular Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) solutions across Southeast Asian economies.
prelims: Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) consists of interoperable, open-source technology stacks like identity, payments, and data exchange.
The ASEAN-India Comprehensive Strategic Partnership drives regional digital integration and financial inclusion.
The framework targets real-time cross-border payment links between UPI and ASEAN national fast-payment networks.
articles.mains: Use under GS2: Bilateral, regional and global groupings involving India and affecting India's interests; DPI as a pillar of India's soft power diplomacy.

articles.title: Implementation Guidelines for BioE3 Policy: Biomanufacturing Ecosystem
articles.summary: Department of Biotechnology releases operational guidelines for high-performance biomanufacturing hubs under the BioE3 Policy.
prelims: BioE3 stands for 'Biotechnology for Economy, Environment, and Employment', led by the Department of Biotechnology (DBT).
Key focus areas include bio-monomers, smart proteins, precision biotherapeutics, and carbon capture utilization.
It introduces Bio-AI hubs and biofoundries to scale up circular bioeconomy research and commercialization.
articles.mains: Use under GS3: Science and Technology developments; Indigenization of technology; Sustainable development and circular bioeconomy.

articles.title: Glacial Lake Outburst Flood (GLOF) Risk Reduction Strategy for the Himalayan Region
articles.summary: NDMA updates its risk mitigation framework for high-risk glacial lakes across the Indian Himalayan Region aligning with Sendai Framework goals.
prelims: GLOFs occur when unstable moraine dams containing glacial lakes breach, releasing large volumes of water.
The Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction (2015-2030) sets 4 priority action areas and 7 global targets.
The strategy mandates IoT-enabled automated weather stations and early warning systems at high-altitude lakes.
articles.mains: Use under GS3: Disaster and disaster management; Environmental impact assessment and climate resilience in ecologically fragile zones.

articles.title: National Energy Storage Systems (ESS) Guidelines for Grid Resilience
articles.summary: Ministry of Power releases framework for integrating grid-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) to support 500 GW non-fossil capacity goals.
prelims: India aims to achieve 500 GW of non-fossil energy capacity by 2030 as part of its Panchamrit commitments.
Battery Energy Storage Systems address duck-curve challenges and intermittency inherent to solar and wind power.
The initiative includes Viability Gap Funding (VGF) support covering up to 40% of capital costs for ESS infrastructure.
articles.mains: Use under GS3: Infrastructure: Energy; Clean energy transition, renewable energy integration, and grid stability.

articles.title: Digital Evidence Management System (DEMS) under Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita
articles.summary: MHA rolls out standard operational procedures for DEMS to maintain cryptographic chain-of-custody for digital evidence under new criminal laws.
prelims: Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023 replaced the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
Section 105 of BNSS mandates videography and photography during search and seizure operations.
DEMS ensures immutable hash logging and standardized electronic record submission admissible in judicial proceedings.
articles.mains: Use under GS2: Government policies and interventions; Technology adoption in judicial and criminal justice reforms.
